name: Orthographic Voxelization and Projection
aliases: Orthographic Voxelization and Projection — 2D metric on voxelized point clouds, Voxel-based quality assessment
definition: A rendering scheme that converts 3D point clouds into a discrete voxel grid and projects them onto 2D planes using orthographic projection to enable objective quality assessment via standard 2D metrics.
summary: Orthographic Voxelization and Projection converts 3D point clouds into voxel grids and projects them onto 2D planes to enable objective quality assessment using standard 2D metrics without interpolation.
